descricao_original: The middle ear, a cavity in the temporal bone, is lined by a mucosa whose epithelium is primarily simple squamous. The middle ear is bounded by the tympanic membrane laterally and the bony wall of the inner ear medially. It communicates with the mastoid air cells posteriorly and with the nasopharynx, via the Eustachian tube, anteriorly. 10x
